errors.start.no_sources: Couldn't start: no node sources are enabled. Add or enable a source in Settings, then start again.
errors.start.no_validated_nodes: Couldn't start: no nodes passed the check. Make sure your nodes and subscriptions are available, then start again.
errors.start.route_verification_failed: Couldn't start: it couldn't be confirmed that traffic goes through the selected node. Check that the node is available, then start again.
errors.start.source_supply_no_egress: Couldn't start: no exit was available to fetch node sources. Check this computer's network connection, or enable a tier that can connect directly, then start again.
errors.start.source_supply_terminal: Couldn't start: the node sources couldn't be fetched. Check your source settings and network, then start again.
errors.start.superseded: Start canceled: a stop was requested.
errors.start.unexpected: Couldn't start: something unexpected went wrong. Restart the service; if it keeps happening, export a diagnostic bundle and report it.
errors.subscriptions.apply_unconfirmed: The subscription was updated, but it couldn't be confirmed that the proxy core loaded it. Restart the service and check again.
errors.subscriptions.core_reload_failed: The subscription was updated, but the proxy core couldn't load the new nodes. Restart the service to apply them.
errors.subscriptions.empty_subscription: The subscription returned no content. Check that the subscription URL is correct and hasn't expired.
errors.subscriptions.lifecycle_busy: The service is starting or stopping, so subscriptions can't be updated right now. Wait for the current step to finish, then update again.
errors.subscriptions.recovery_pending: The previous network settings are still being restored, so subscriptions can't be updated right now. Try again shortly.
errors.subscriptions.refresh_failed: The subscription update failed. Check the subscription URL and your network, then try again.
errors.subscriptions.refresh_in_progress: This subscription is already updating. Wait for it to finish.
errors.subscriptions.refresh_rejected: The subscription update wasn't accepted. Check the subscription settings, then try again.
errors.subscriptions.refresh_unconfirmed: It couldn't be confirmed that the subscription was updated. Refresh later to check.
errors.subscriptions.unknown_item: This subscription can't be found; it may have been deleted. Refresh the list, then try again.
errors.superseded: This action was replaced by a later one; the latest result applies.
errors.timeout: The action timed out before it could finish. Check your network, then try again.
errors.unknown: An unrecognized error occurred. Try again; if it keeps happening, export a diagnostic bundle and report it.
errors.update.operation_failed: The update failed. Check your network, then check for updates again.
errors.validation: Some of what you entered isn't valid. Fix it as indicated, then try again.
errors.validation.field: This value isn't valid. Fix it as indicated, then save again.
errors.settings.alerts_endpoint_changed: This channel's destination changed. To avoid sending saved secrets to the new destination, this section wasn't saved. Re-enter or clear this channel's keys, tokens, and credential headers, then save again.
